usefulness.rationale: The dossier's substantive content rests on a single news article (sdpnoticias.com, via Bing News redirect) about the Faro Santander opening. The identity anchors give the reader only a sketch — name, birth details, role as chair since 2014, family lineage — without the article text to support career details. A reader learns who she is (Santander chair, fourth-generation family chair) and one recent activity (announcing a cultural venue), but nothing about her business career, the 2014 appointment, leadership at the bank, or the acquisitions, rankings, and 1999 episode referenced in the unjustified-conclusions list. All four dossier claims carry 'contested' or single-citation status; three claims share the same sole citation and source, so there is no corroboration. The gaps are visible (one-source dependency is apparent from citations), but the dossier never explicitly states what it does not know. A reader could not meaningfully prepare for a meeting beyond knowing her title and one announcement.
